messages:
Elena (Product): FYI — ACME pilot asks for a softened onramp: 3 months of 50% usage credits + relaxed throughput caps and a muted overage policy. They said it's blocking signature unless we do something lightweight. Legal asked for a templated clause. Want to decide whether this is a temporary promo or an actual addon SKU. Opinions? :thinking:

Aj (Sales): They flagged ROI uncertainty on month 1. If we make them commit immediately they walk. Willing to accept a small temporary concession if we can enforce a clear graduation path. I can push for a month-2 convert trigger.

Sam (Pricing): Proposal: "soft-onramp-credit" (temporary promo SKU) with these guards:
- 3 months max per account
- Credit = 50% of invoice tokens, capped at $50k total credit
- Throughput softcap = 2x baseline (no SLA)
- Trigger: if customer increases sustained usage > X tokens for 14 days, auto-convert to paid tier or require commitment discussion

Example SLA snippet for rollout notes:
```
soft_onramp: {
  duration_days: 90,
  credit_pct: 50,
  credit_cap_usd: 50000,
  throughput_multiplier: 2,
  sla: "best-effort, no latency SLA during soft-onramp"
}
```

Sam (Pricing): Risk: revenue leakage and precedence. Need opt-in on a per-account basis and manual sign-off from AMs.

Dani (Legal): For contract clause: keep it short and explicit. Suggest a 2-paragraph amendment: one describing the credit mechanics and expiry, another stating this is a promotional concession and does not modify standard SLAs or entitlement to priority support. Also require that ACME accepts a termination/rollback clause if they exceed the throughput multiplier repeatedly. I'll draft a template.

Grace (Eng): Capacity question: we can expose a burst pool but must enforce token-level rate-limits per account. If multiple big pilots request the same, it can starve Dedicated customers. Suggest: route soft-onramp traffic to a capped burst cluster and enable an auto-fallback to a cheaper model variant when burst quota exhausted. Need a config flag: `route: soft_onramp_burst_pool=true`. Also need a monitoring alert.

Olivia (RevOps): Billing/ops: implement as a discount line on invoices (non-recurring) and track via `promo_code` tag. We need one-time migration script to convert accounts that activate into the billing ledger. Also require alerting: send AM/RevOps an email when credit usage hits 70% and 100%.

Elena (Product): OK good tradeoffs. To make a call, propose launch criteria checklist: 1) Signed onramp amendment template from Legal; 2) Pricing guardrails documented + AM signoff; 3) Billing flow implemented (discount line and alerts); 4) Rate-limit + routing configured and smoke-tested; 5) Rollback policy defined (auto-fallback to paid or throttled model). If all green we can ship as "pilot promo" not an official addon.

Aj (Sales): I'll confirm ACME acceptance metrics and get a verbal ok today, then push for signature. I'll also capture case comparisons so we don't set precedent.

Sam (Pricing): Add one more check: revenue protection clause that prevents repeated renewals of the credit for same account.

Dani (Legal): Noted. I'll draft the amendment and include the rollback/renewal language. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Grace (Eng): I'll carve the burst pool and add the routing flag. ETA 3 days for config + 1 day smoke.

Olivia (RevOps): I'll create the billing template and alerts. Need a devops ticket for the ledger tag.

Elena (Product): Cool — sounds like we have an actionable plan. If everyone completes their tasks, we can offer ACME the 90-day soft-onramp as a pilot. Please add blockers here. :thumbsup:
